name: io.github.brodesigns/gsc-readonly-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the Google Search Console API. No write scope at all.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud service account JSON key file with Search Console API access.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Default property, e.g. 'https://example.com/' or 'sc-domain:example.com'. Optional, every tool also accepts a site_url argument.
